nativeStylesheet.effect: Global * assigns Chewy, cursive; existing page resets and native deathscreen layout affect inherited UI. Include in preview before BRIO CSS.

capturedFont.origin: Captured fonts.gstatic.com/s/chewy/v11/uK_94ruUb-k-wn52KjI.woff2; verified WOFF2 header, no network refetch

liveCapture.scope: Viewport/DPR/visual scale, font readiness/descriptors and allowlisted computed box/style metrics. No HTML, input values, player-name text, screenshot, new timer/network/source execution.

limits: DOM/style metrics establish constraints, not pixel identity. Design previews must share component HTML/CSS/assets with eventual in-game implementation and match viewport, native CSS cascade and font rendering. Chat may scale screenshots. Native canvas background remains dynamic; final integrated review still required.
